review_scope: Bounded adversarial review of the scientific terminal decision, processor-only evidence, held-out gate, physical-call compliance, and report claims.

independent_findings.finding: No audited local family supplies a disjoint, exhaustive, trusted enter_ego_path relation; stopping before model generation is supported.
The preserved runner source, warning, schedules, and outputs strongly support the 121-to-122-to-10-frame reconstruction, but the exact v1 dependency image and model-input tensors were not preserved.
A coordinate warp derived from processor patch centers is not semantic event-localization ground truth and must be labeled and reported separately.
The final-partial audit cited an abbreviated JUnit selector rather than the exact parametrized test name.
The bundle demonstrates zero v2 calls locally; it is not an independent external scheduler/accounting audit.
The frozen int(source_fps/2) stride plus 121-frame cap may reject some 60-second non-integer-FPS media and must be checked before future held-out authorization.

items.request: Exercise the exact old helper-to-processor call signature on a sentinel and cover every nominal legacy call.
items.resolution: PASS: test_exact_v1_helper_to_processor_call_compresses_sentinel_frames and test_all_68_nominal_old_calls_have_the_reconstructed_compression both pass in the sealed 25-test JUnit result.

items.request: Separate coordinate-warp diagnostics from semantic localization.
items.resolution: PASS: OLD_COORDINATE_WARP_DIAGNOSTICS.csv has 102 explicitly non-semantic boundary rows; OLD_COORDINATE_WARP_SUMMARY.json reports 67 interpolation-supported and 35 outside-timeline boundaries, while semantic localization remains NOT_MEASURED.

items.request: Use the exact final-partial JUnit selector.
items.resolution: PASS: the pre-execution audit resolves the full timeline_73p4s_10fps.mp4-partial-70.0-73.4-7 selector.

items.request: State the scope of the zero-call evidence and the non-integer-FPS caveat.
items.resolution: PASS: the final reporting identifies bundle-local evidence only and makes FPS/frame-count compatibility a preauthorization task.

residual_caveats: The exact v1 dependency image, serialized chat, processor metadata object, input tensors, and temporal position IDs were not preserved; the reconstruction is artifact/source-supported under pinned current dependencies rather than a replay of old model generation.
Zero-call evidence is confined to bundle files, ledgers, and local process artifacts; no external scheduler or cluster-accounting audit was available.

Before any future reference is exposed to inference or any physical call is authorized, source FPS/frame counts must be checked against the frozen selection rule; incompatibility requires an event-independent refreeze and a repeated processor audit.

final_read_only_verification.verification_scope: Post-remediation sealed bundle, distinct from the primary-agent remediation check.
final_read_only_verification.provenance_note: The independent reviewer inspected but did not rerun the sealed JUnit and made no file edits.
